# A follow-on autocomplete reduction preserves the previous display label

The accepted narrowing path only reuses a successful compatible previous result and copies its getValueAt and getLabelAt separately. test_nsAbAutoCompleteSearch2 builds results without address books and uses an en-dash label, then expects that exact label; fresh labels use an em dash. Preserve previous labels in this branch rather than silently regenerating them from the current formatter. The dash difference is not evidence for a general punctuation standard or an author’s unstated intent. This is static source and test-code inspection. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline and inline discussion remain pending; source landing does not prove approval of a proposed manual rule.

Scope: autocomplete cache behavior.
